message.reasoning: We need to fill fuel tank. The tank capacity is up to 50 gallons. We have 10 liters. Need to convert to gallons? The function fillFuelTank expects fuelAmount in gallons. We need to determine how many gallons to add to fill to capacity. But we don't know current fuel level in gallons. We have fuelLevel 10.0 liters. We need to convert 10 liters to gallons: 1 liter = 0.264172 gallons. So 10 liters = 2.64172 gallons. Tank capacity 50 gallons. So need to add 47.35828 gallons. But we might just fill to full: fillFuelTank with fuelAmount = 50 - current gallons. But we don't know current gallons. We can approximate: 10 liters ~ 2.64 gallons. So need to add 47.36 gallons. Use fillFuelTank with fuelAmount 47.36.
